digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery (async, library, MCP paths)
propositions: A failed tickets-branch push is undeliverable on three paths: async (detached Popen discards stderr), library embedders (NullHandler swallows warnings), and MCP agents (handler targets server stderr not tool result).
The durable marker `push_state.py` records terminal push failures at the single `_raise_if_strict` choke point that all delivery paths route through, making failures observable despite stderr loss.
The async path observes the marker via polling on a bounded deadline (60s/0.1s), the library path via `rebar.push_status()`, and MCP via a `push_status` field on write-tool results.

Commit-phase reasons (stage-failed, commit-failed, commit-lock-timeout) and recovery reasons are recorded as pending with reason and phase, while non-failure reasons (push-disabled, remote-not-found, invalid-destination) are explicitly excluded to prevent alarm fatigue in local-only stores.

The marker lives in the git dir (not working tree) to preserve byte-identical `git status` on failed push and be unreachable by committed tree; it has no `.json` suffix to avoid miscount by ticket-event scanners.

A successful push clears the marker; the contract that push_tickets_branch always returns None and never raises on the default path is preserved; best-effort recording tolerates marker-write failures.
